column1: # Conservative public-access ASN list for the three mainland China carriers.
# This is an ASN-level approximation. An ASN can contain both residential and
# non-residential subscribers, so it cannot prove that an individual IP is a
# home broadband line. Separately originated IDC, cloud, IoT, 5G-only,
# industrial Internet and premium international networks are intentionally not
# included. In particular, AS4809 (CN2), AS9929 (CUII) and AS58453 (CMI) are
# Selection evidence and maintenance policy are documented in README.md.
